title: Kissed Yeasty Peruvian Oxtail Rocoto Relleno
description: A Peruvian dish featuring oxtail and cheese in a rocoto relleno form, wrapped in a ti leaf, perfect for a brunch mood. This shojin-friendly recipe combines yeasty and cheesy flavors with tender oxtail.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the oxtail to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add yeast to the pot and stir to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise the oxtail for 2 hours, or until tender.
While the oxtail is cooking, roast the rocoto peppers over an open flame or in the oven until charred and peeled.
Once the oxtail is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool, then shred it into bite-sized pieces.
Stuff each roasted rocoto pepper with the shredded oxtail, cheese, and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
Wrap each stuffed pepper in a ti leaf and secure with a toothpick if necessary.
Serve the rocoto relleno warm, garnished with additional cheese and yeast if desired.
